data.title: Bohill Forest
data.extract: Bohill Forest is a small coniferous forest located near Drumaness, County Down, Northern Ireland. It is managed by the Forest Service Northern Ireland and includes a designated nature reserve established to protect the habitat of the holly blue butterfly. The Bohill Forest Nature Reserve covers approximately 2.8 hectares within the larger forest area of 38.96 hectares. It is situated at grid reference J396459, about 4 miles southeast of Ballynahinch.
